evidence.title: MetaCaster: Meta-Harness-Optimized Agent for End-to-End Few-Shot Learning of Lightweight Time Series Forecasters

summary: Meta AI unveiled MetaCaster, an agent that leverages a meta‑harness to perform end‑to‑end few‑shot training of compact time‑series forecasting models, enabling rapid adaptation with minimal data. Benchmarks show the approach outperforms existing lightweight forecasters on standard datasets, highlighting its potential for real‑time forecasting applications.
title: MetaCaster introduces meta‑harness‑optimized agent for few‑shot, end‑to‑end learning of lightweight time‑series forecasters
